proposed_decisions: Glyph \(\phi\) is used as the location-scale log form function (Fisher's notation, thm:p15-w02b-p15-057-location-scale) and \(\phi_B\) as conditional-probability version in def:p15-w02b-p15-057-sufficiency; scopes are disjoint labels within the chapter.
Glyphs m,a,p follow Fisher's Type III notation in sec:p15-w02b-p15-057-type-iii; p there is a shape parameter, not a probability as in def:p15-fe-binomial.
J denotes the information matrix here; sec:p15-fisher-estimation uses J(eta) for scalar finite information. Same role, compatible.
Glyph \(s\) is the vector score in def:p15-w02b-p15-057-multi-conditions and \(s_	heta\) the scalar score in def:p15-w02b-p15-057-regular; same role, compatible.
Glyph \(\psi\) (digamma) in thm:p15-w02b-p15-057-typeiii-joint; check against any registry use of psi as a test function in P15.
Glyph \(g\) is an estimand gradient in def:p15-w02b-p15-057-multi-efficiency; g_theta in thm:p15-w02b-p15-057-factorization is a factorization factor; scopes are disjoint labels.
Glyph \(r\) is the Type IV/VII form parameter in thm:p15-w02b-p15-057-typeiv (Fisher's notation), and \(\nu\) its skewness parameter; scopes limited to that theorem.
Glyph \(K\) is the number of cells in def:p15-w02b-p15-057-grouped; \(\mathcal K\) is a local compact set in the annex proof only.

Glyphs \(\mathcal D_D\), \(\mathcal W_D\), \(\mathcal V_D\) and \(D\) (set of dilutions) are scoped to def:p15-w02b-p15-057-dilution; \(s\) there is the number of plates per dilution (Fisher p. 364), not the score of def:p15-w02b-p15-057-regular; \(n\) there is the organism density (Fisher), not a sample size.
Glyph \(m\) is the Poisson mean in thm:p15-w02b-p15-057-poisson (Fisher p. 359), distinct from the Type III origin m of sec:p15-w02b-p15-057-type-iii; scopes are disjoint labels.

Glyphs \(\sigma_1,\sigma_2\) are Fisher's normal-scale statistics in thm:p15-w02b-p15-057-normal-scale and standard deviations in thm:p15-w02b-p15-057-suff-eff (both Fisher pp. 316-317 notation); scopes are the two theorem labels.
Glyph \(r\) is a correlation in thm:p15-w02b-p15-057-suff-eff, distinct from the Type IV form parameter r of thm:p15-w02b-p15-057-typeiv.

Glyph \(D(p)\) in thm:p15-w02b-p15-057-typeiii-largep is distinct from Fisher's discrepancy D of def:p15-fg-cells used in thm:p15-w02b-p15-057-chisq-sampling; \(\mathcal N(p)\) chosen to avoid the normal-law N and the sample size N.
Glyph \(\Phi\) (standard normal distribution function) in sec:p15-w02b-p15-057-three-statements; registry has Phi as a P8 formula metavariable/filtration set; check any P15 registry entry for Phi.
Glyph \(n'\) on p. 358 (one more than the degrees of freedom) is quoted in prose only, distinct from the Type III ratio n' of thm:p15-w02b-p15-057-typeiii-joint.

Glyph \(J\) in thm:p15-w02b-p15-057-sandwich is the scalar expected negative curvature under the sampling law Q; distinct from the information matrix J of sec:p15-w02b-p15-057-several; scope is the theorem label.
Glyph \(B\) in thm:p15-w02b-p15-057-sandwich (score variance under Q) is distinct from B_n (integrated curvature) in the annex proofs.
Glyph \(F\) on p. 351 (Fisher's Type IV normalizing integral) is quoted in sec:p15-w02b-p15-057-pearson only; distinct from Fisher's trigamma-type F in sec:p15-w02b-p15-057-type-iii.
Glyphs \(x,y\) in def:p15-w02b-p15-057-pearson-system and thm:p15-w02b-p15-057-contours are Fisher's diagram coordinates (p. 345), not observations; scope those labels.
Glyph \(T\) in thm:p15-w02b-p15-057-quartic is the statistic vector (x,...,x^4); distinct from estimator T_n elsewhere in the chapter.
Glyph \(\epsilon\) is Fisher's diagram quantity 4 epsilon = r^2+nu^2 (p. 345), scope def:p15-w02b-p15-057-pearson-system.
Symbol Z is reused: Z(theta) (quartic family normalizer, thm quartic) and Z(nu,r) (Type I/II normalizer, thm form-ii); scopes are disjoint theorem labels.
Symbol Lambda: \Lambda_Q (def pseudo-true) and \Lambda (sign matrix, thm form-vii) share a base glyph in different scopes.

Glyph r denotes degrees of freedom K-1-q inside thm:p15-w02b-p15-057-chisq-law and lemma lindeberg-vector, and the Type IV/VII exponent elsewhere in the chapter; scopes are disjoint theorem labels. J(epsilon) in thm linear-end is a scalar integral, local to that theorem, distinct from the information matrix J.
